name: [W2] +1 Speed Ninja Escape
desc:
🐱‍👤 Use you NINJA SKILLS to Reach The End! ⛩️

How To Play :
- Train on the Treadmill to gain SPEED 👟
- Use Dash, Doube Jump and Wallrun to beat the Obstacles 🏃
- Earn Trophies by reaching new Stages 🏆
- Unlock New Ninjas⭐

Controls:
Space x2 : Double Jump
E : Dash
